name: Bitcoin Price
overview: Learn how spot prices, order-book liquidity and exchange volume differ.
practice: Compare quoting currencies and timestamps before treating a price as a benchmark.

name: Ethereum Markets
overview: Follow ETH pricing, network demand and market-structure indicators.
practice: Separate asset price from transaction cost and ecosystem adoption.

name: Altcoin Research
overview: Compare token purposes, circulating supply, liquidity and concentration.
practice: Check issuance and unlock schedules before comparing market caps.

name: Stablecoins
overview: Understand reserves, redemption mechanisms and de-pegging scenarios.
practice: Look for published reserve attestations and issuer redemption policies.

name: Market Heatmaps
overview: Interpret relative price changes across coins and sectors.
practice: Check whether a heatmap is weighted by market cap or simple percentages.

name: Crypto Market Capitalization
overview: Understand price-times-supply valuation and its limitations.
practice: Use circulating supply rather than maximum supply for spot market-cap estimates.

name: Tokenomics
overview: Investigate supply design, emission rates, vesting and governance.
practice: Separate circulating, total and maximum supply and inspect token unlocks.

name: Gas Fees
overview: Explain blockchain transaction fees and factors affecting cost.
practice: Compare network, operation complexity and current fee conditions.

name: Layer 2 Networks
overview: Explore scaling networks, bridging assumptions and transaction finality.
practice: Check canonical bridge security, withdrawal delays and chain identity.

name: Blockchain Explorers
overview: Read transaction hashes, block confirmations and contract activity.
practice: Verify contract addresses against primary project documentation.

name: Mining Economics
overview: Understand hash rate, electricity, equipment and reward variability.
practice: Model energy costs and mining difficulty before estimating profitability.

name: Staking Basics
overview: Review validation rewards, lockups, penalties and custody choices.
practice: Distinguish advertised annualized yields from realized net rewards.

name: Decentralized Finance
overview: Learn lending, swaps, collateral and smart-contract exposure.
practice: Inspect contract audits, liquidity depth and liquidation mechanics.

name: Liquidity Pools
overview: Understand swap fees, impermanent loss and pool concentration.
practice: Consider pool composition and volatility when comparing quoted yields.

name: Wallet Management
overview: Understand self-custody, seed phrases, signing and recovery.
practice: Never enter secret recovery phrases into a website or a public tool.

name: Hardware Wallets
overview: Compare offline key storage, signing workflows and device recovery.
practice: Verify authenticity, firmware provenance and backup procedures.

name: Phishing & Scam Signals
overview: Recognize fake airdrops, approval scams and impersonation tactics.
practice: Check domains and token approvals before connecting a wallet.

name: Smart Contract Risk
overview: Explore contract privileges, upgradeability and exploit patterns.
practice: Assess admin-key permissions, audits and known incidents.

name: Crypto Regulations
overview: Track differing jurisdictional approaches to digital assets.
practice: Read effective legal text and verify country-specific restrictions.

name: Crypto Tax Concepts
overview: Understand disposal, cost basis and recordkeeping principles.
practice: Consult current local tax guidance rather than applying another country's rules.

name: Portfolio Allocation
overview: Compare exposure, concentration and rebalancing methods.
practice: Calculate position sizes using consistent valuation dates and currencies.

name: Profit & Loss Calculator
overview: Estimate gains after fees for trades and transfers.
practice: Include entry fees, exit fees and currency conversion in net returns.

name: Volatility Analytics
overview: Understand historical price variation and downside risk.
practice: Use comparable time windows and avoid interpreting volatility as certainty.

name: Market Sentiment
overview: Explore sentiment indicators and their construction.
practice: Check methodology and lag before relating sentiment to price movement.

name: On-chain Activity
overview: Interpret transaction counts, active addresses and value transfer.
practice: Account for batching, bots and cross-chain activity in metrics.

name: Exchange Comparison
overview: Compare execution fees, withdrawal rules and custody models.
practice: Check local access, withdrawal limits and current terms.

name: Cross-chain Bridges
overview: Understand wrapped assets and interoperability risk.
practice: Review issuer model, lock-and-mint mechanisms and bridge incidents.

name: Bitcoin Halving
overview: Understand issuance changes and the block-reward schedule.
practice: Distinguish protocol events from speculative future price effects.

name: Crypto Glossary
overview: Decode commonly used blockchain and trading terminology.
practice: Use precise definitions for supply, finality, liquidity and custody.

name: Crypto News & Research
overview: Read evidence-backed protocol and market developments.
practice: Prefer primary announcements and date-stamped source links.
